image_description: A vertical shot of a steep, textured rock cliff face. Three human figures are visible on the cliff: one near the top in dark clothing, one in the middle wearing a teal patterned shirt, and one at the bottom in red pants. The figures appear to be climbing or interacting with the rock face, but their anatomical structures and connections to the rock show signs of AI generation artifacts (melting/fusion). Vegetation (moss/bushes) clings to the left side of the cliff.

The figure at the bottom has distorted limbs; the legs seem to float or attach incorrectly to the body/rock. The anatomy is severely broken.

Slight smearing or 'painterly' blur in the rock texture immediately surrounding the human figures, suggesting generation difficulties with object-background interaction.

Audit the structural integrity of the three human figures. Low confidence or missing keypoints will confirm the visual suspicion of melted limbs.
Check for boundary bleeding between the climbers and the rock face to quantify the 'fusion' artifacts.
Ensure the cliff has valid 3D depth and isn't a flat texture map, and check if climbers are properly grounded in 3D space.
Holistic assessment of generation quality, focusing on the unnatural blending of subjects.

Boundary sharpness between climbers and the cliff face.
Physical plausibility of climbing poses (gravity/contact points).

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'animal_pose_auditor' results for the humans. Even though they are not animals, the keypoint detection will fail catastrophically if the limbs are melted, which serves as strong evidence of structural artifacts. Do not let the realistic rock texture distract from the severe anatomical failures of the climbers. The class label is 'cliff', but the presence of malformed humans significantly impacts the overall image quality and realism.
